% Pattern: kind/conclusion/article. A Conclusion environment that steps the
% counter of the theorems states a result and is a corollary. A Conclusion of
% its own counter is a closing section.
% from math/9201244, math/9802134
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1
% want conclusion-1 statement/corollary 2
% want summary-1 other/section 1
\documentclass{article}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\newtheorem{conclusion}[theorem]{Conclusion}
\newtheorem{summary}{Conclusion}
\begin{document}
\begin{theorem} Each tree is a graph. \end{theorem}
\begin{conclusion} Each path is a graph. \end{conclusion}
\begin{summary} We have shown two facts. \end{summary}
\end{document}
